title: Pinned WDI BigQuery authored definitions
summary: Documentation-only: five metadata table schemas, all nullable; country_summary has country_code, two_alpha_code and wb_2_code; series_summary carries unit_of_measure, periodicity, source and license_type; series_time.year INTEGER versus footnotes.year STRING. Dataset Terraform uses var.project_id and specifies no location. Current existence, data, constraints, edition, freshness, source-project ownership and observations remain unverified.
